about: The Epistle of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Owe no man anything except to love one another, for he that loveth his neighbor hath fulfilled the law. For: Thou shalt not commit adultery, thou shalt not kill, thou shalt not steal, thou shalt not bear false witness, thou shalt not covet—and if there be any other commandment—it is summed up in this word: Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself. Love worketh no evil to a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfilling of the law.

a.g: you shall not bear false witness
